title: PIC Verify Output
description: Result of PIC Standard verification with workflow routing decision.

allowed.description: Whether PIC verification succeeded for this proposed action.

eval_ms.description: Time in milliseconds the PIC bridge took to evaluate the proposal.

next.description: Workflow routing decision. 'fail' means the workflow must abort; 'require_approval' means route to a human approval step; 'proceed' means continue.

impact.description: PIC impact classification (e.g. "money", "privacy", "irreversible"), or null if not classified.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the decision, or null if no details available.
